name: FlowState
description: Local-first shared project memory for AI apps: an MIT MCP server that stores todos, changes, decisions, problems and learnings in SQLite on the user's machine. Reads keep Guard's usual handling; writes that reshape memory, rules, projects or the review queue are gated on review. Off until you turn it on.
saferAlternatives: This entry matches uvx flowstatemcp over stdio, the usual install from PyPI. Configs that run the flowstate or flowstatemcp console script directly (pip install or a git clone) or python -m flowstate keep Guard's normal handling.

start_here and search are read-oriented. log_work stays on review because it writes decisions, changes, problems, learnings and todos to project memory; manage_sessions stays on review because start and end change project state.
manage_review (approve/reject/set_mode) stays on review so an agent cannot silently clear the human review queue or change review mode.
manage_projects delete, manage_memory delete/import and manage_data_git clone/sync/set_remote stay on review; FlowState already safety-copies before deletes.

DialectForge FlowState is published on PyPI as flowstatemcp (uvx flowstatemcp or pipx run flowstatemcp). The unrelated PyPI package named flowstate is not this server; do not uvx or pipx that name for it.
A separate paid Hosted endpoint (hosted.flowstatemcp.com/mcp) is remote HTTP and is not covered by this local uvx entry.
